faqs.question: What is GEO Optimizer?
faqs.answer: GEO Optimizer is an open-source Python toolkit that audits websites for AI search engine visibility. It scores sites 0-100 with deterministic rule checks and generates fixes for robots.txt, llms.txt, JSON-LD schema, and meta tags. Install with: pip install geo-optimizer-skill

faqs.question: How is the GEO score calculated?
faqs.answer: The default rubric (v2, since engine 4.19.0) scores 9 categories for 100 points: Google AI readiness 20, robots.txt AI bot access 14, JSON-LD schema 14, content 14, brand & entity 12, meta tags 11, llms.txt 6, signals 6, AI discovery 3. The legacy v1 rubric (8 categories) is still available with geo audit --score-version 1. Bands: 86-100 excellent, 68-85 good, 36-67 foundation, 0-35 critical.

faqs.question: What are the 47 citability checks?
faqs.answer: GEO Optimizer measures content citability with 47 checks. 9 of them are taken directly from the methods tested in the KDD 2024 GEO paper (arXiv:2311.09735). In that benchmark, quotation addition raised a source's position-adjusted visibility by about 41% over no optimization, and statistics addition by about 33% on the word-count metric. These are relative gains in a visibility metric under research conditions, not citation rates. The checks also include RAG readiness signals such as answer capsules, token efficiency and entity resolution.

faqs.question: How do I use GEO Optimizer with Claude or Cursor?
faqs.answer: GEO Optimizer includes an MCP server with 12 tools. Install with: pip install geo-optimizer-skill[mcp], then: claude mcp add geo-optimizer -- geo-mcp. You can then ask Claude to audit sites, generate fixes, and analyze citability directly.

faqs.question: Can I run GEO audits in CI/CD?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use the GitHub Action: uses: Auriti-Labs/geo-optimizer-skill@v1 with url and threshold inputs. Supports SARIF output for GitHub Security tab and JUnit for Jenkins/GitLab. Fails the build if score drops below threshold.

faqs.question: What AI bots does GEO Optimizer track?
faqs.answer: GEO Optimizer tracks 27 AI bots across 3 tiers: training (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider, CCBot, and more), search (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot, Applebot, Bingbot, xAI-Bot, DuckAssistBot, YouBot, Amazonbot), and user-fetch (ChatGPT-User, Claude-User, Perplexity-User, Meta-ExternalFetcher, facebookexternalhit). The robots.txt score checks the citation bots OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot and Applebot; allowing them makes a site eligible for AI answers, it does not guarantee citation.
